item.title: 10 Best Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Replacements
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: [Filtered: Game recommendations/alternatives list; filler-adjacent content.] If Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave has got you craving more tactical battles and plenty of allies to recruit, here are a few of our favorites
item.content:encoded: It's been several weeks now since Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weavewas released for Nintendo Switch 2, and fans around the world are still exploring this massive game. While you could easily sink hundreds of hours into playing through every Flame Lord's story, you may be wondering what to play after your adventures in Dagda are through. Worry not: we've compiled a list of games like Fortune's Weave to keep your strategic skills sharp while you wait for the story expansion DLC that's slated to be released sometime in 2027. While many of the games on this list are strategy RPGs, some incorporate other standout elements of Fortune's Weave, like its tournament-focused story or the opportunity to recruit dozens of allies.

item.title: 4 Upcoming Fantasy RPGs Better Than Waiting for a New Dragon Age
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Corgan
item.description: [Filtered: Game recommendations list; alternatives-based filler content.] Want more Dragon Age? These four upcoming RPGs, one playable today, deliver the companions, tactical fights, and choices that follow you around.
item.content:encoded: The fire’s burning low. The road ahead looks grim. The companion who has spent half your journey needling you clearly has something on their mind, and you’re one or two correct dialogue choices away from getting them to spill. You pick a reply. You feel it land. Then somebody makes a joke about cheese, and the tension breaks.

item.title: How to get the Sinking Lure in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Sinking Lure makes fishing easier in Ocarina of Time, but also helps hook the Hylian loach. Here's where it's located and how to get it.
item.content:encoded: The Sinking Lure is an optional item you can find in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but the conditions for finding it are a little confusing. The lure itself isn't necessary for beating the game, and you can't even leave the fishing pond with it, so don't fret if this is something you're stuck on.

item.title: Nobody Said The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Was This Funny
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective of old game with no new substance.] It may be impossible to play Zelda: Ocarina of Time totally free of spoilers in 2026, but the jokes are 100% fresh.
item.content:encoded: Though I’ve never played The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time until now, I’ve heard people sing its praises for years. Mostly, this revolved around its impossibly high score of 99 on Metacritic, its influential open world and combat design, and its memorable dungeons. But none of those ardent fans bothered to tell me that this classic game has some genuinely hilarious moments. Because the game was originally released 28 years ago, a spoiler-free experience is pretty much off the table for me. But the goofs and gags? Those are all 100% fresh.

item.title: Batman Just Officially Saved DC Comics From a Terrible Fate
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise DC churn: casting/business gossip, not prestige film.] After James Gunn is ousted by Skydance, DC Comics may have avoided a similiar fate thanks to Absolute Batman
item.content:encoded: Business mergers always come with shake-ups, and Skydance's recent acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery was inevitably going to be messy in some way. What was unexpected, however, was this week's announcement that James Gunn and Peter Safran would be stepping down as co-heads of DC Studios. At the same time, Skydance has initiated layoffs in other divisions such as Skydance Games. One area that seems to have escaped the chopping block for now, though, is DC Comics.

item.title: How to unlock Fire Arrows in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how to unlock fire arrows in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and the prerequisites you must meet.
item.content:encoded: Unlocking Fire Arrows is a great way to expand Link's arsenal in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Timeremake. By hitting targets with these special arrows, Link can set them on fire, which is fairly useful in different scenarios, from fighting certain enemies to lighting totems to open doors. Before you can get your hands on them, you will need to progress through the story and solve a riddle.

item.title: Target's New 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary Drawing Is A Must-See For TCG Fans
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG retail/restock story; trading card scalper content.] Target is raffling Ascended Heroes & the best Pokémon TCG set of 2026 for a limited time, and it's a good deal when you break down cost-per-pack
item.content:encoded: Pokémon fans were thrilled to hear about Target's new trading card game raffle system, which gives collectors a fairer chance to secure products against retail bots. The retailer initially debuted the drawing system with a small three-pack of an older Pokémon set, Destined Rivals. Now, however, Target has begun raffling out two products fans were hoping for all along: the 30th Anniversary TCG set, and the Ascended Heroes set.

item.title: Costco’s New 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary Bundle Is An Unbelievable Deal
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG retail/pricing story; trading card scalper content.] Pokémon TCG collectors can nab a 30th Anniversary ETB and Booster Bundle cheaper than at Target, Walmart, and Best Buy
item.content:encoded: Warehouse retailer Costco is determined to blow its competitors out of the water when it comes to selling Pokémon Trading Card Game products. A couple of months after debuting the best Pokémon deal of 2026, the members-only retailer is back with another offer that sounds too good to be true. This time, Costco's promotion targets Pokémon collectors hunting for the elusive30th Anniversary collection.

item.title: Doomsday Officially Comes to Marvel Rivals With an X-Men Icon
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise Marvel churn: hero announcements and casting gossip.] Marvel Rivals announced its next two heroes coming to Season 11.
item.content:encoded: As usual with Marvel Rivals, it seems NetEase’s hints about the game's next hero panned out. Nightcrawler is on the way. He's releasing Season 11: Doomsday, which will be out on Nov. 13. The animated trailer revealing this beloved X-Man does a great job of conveying the character’s selflessness as he warps to and fro to save as many innocent bystanders as he can before getting hit by an airplane. Is it a little on the nose when he warps onto a cross as the sun filters in like a Renaissance painting? Yes, but it goes very hard. Nightcrawler’s official announcement comes after NetEase teased his appearance in the Gallery Card hints, and after a leak from well-known Rivals dataminer X0X_LEAK.

item.title: A Sci-Fi Novel Just Won the Booker Prize for the First Time
item.dc:creator: Francesco Cacciatore
item.description: [Filtered: Book/literary news, not game-related or horror content.] M. John Harrison is the first science fiction author to win the Booker Prize, receiving the award for his novel The End of Everything
item.content:encoded: M. John Harrison's The End of Everything was awarded the 2026 Booker Prize. This marks the first time that a sci-fi novel has won the prestigious literary award for works of fiction in English published in the United Kingdom or Ireland.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Dinosaurs That Prove Gary Larson Is a Mad Genius
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Retrospective list of old comic strips, not game/horror related.] The Far Side ran from 1980 until 1995 and Larson created over 4,000 strips during that time. Dozens of them featured dinosaurs.

item.title: The Settlers of Catan Movie Has Finally Found Its Directors
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Casual adaptation casting news without substantial prestige elements.] Netflix has tapped Aaron and Adam Nee to direct its live-action Catan adaptation based on the best-selling board game.
item.content:encoded: Netflix's upcoming adaptation of The Settlers of Catan is starting to take shape, with the popular board game officially one step closer to becoming a live-action movie. The streaming service has tapped a film-making duo to director the film — the first official move from the project since it was announced.

item.title: M. Night Shyamalan's The Visit: Now Free on YouTube
item.dc:creator: Rachel Tolleson
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: streaming clickbait headline] Revisit M. Night Shyamalan's underrated horror film, The Visit, now streaming free on YouTube. Don't miss it!
item.content:encoded: Though Halloween is over, that doesn't mean that horror movies need to be put on the shelf until next year. In fact, it could even be argued that November is a perfect time to continue watching them. Writer/director M. Night Shyamalan has no shortage of horror films that can work in the chilly, dreary days of November, such as 2004's The Village. But an underrated 2015 found-footage horror film manages to cement itself in Shyamalan's filmography as one of his greatest unexpected achievements.

item.title: How to get the Biggoron Sword in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Biggoron Sword is the reward for the "From a Pocket Egg Comes..." quest in Ocarina of Time. Here's how to complete the quest and get the sword.
item.content:encoded: Biggoron's Sword is the strongest sword in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. However, it's also the most time-consuming weapon to get in the entire game.

item.title: HBO Max-Paramount Plus Bundle Officially Confirmed for 2027
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Generic streaming business news, not game or prestige content.] HBO Max and Paramount+ are launching a streaming bundle in early 2027, bringing two major services together for subscribers.
item.content:encoded: HBO Max and Paramount Plus are officially joining forces, with a new streaming bundle set to launch in early 2027. Skydance Corporation, which completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery in October, confirmed the plans in its third-quarter shareholder letter on Monday.

item.title: Superman Sequel Will Officially Introduce the DCU’s Wonder Woman, Report Says
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: [Filtered: DC casting gossip; big-franchise churn Steven tosses consistently.] James Gunn has stepped down from a leadership role at DC, but is still wrapping up Man of Tomorrow. A new report claims Wonder Woman will be in it.
item.content:encoded: On Monday, James Gunn and Peter Safran stepped down from their leadership roles at DC Studios. Skydance — which recently finalized its acquisition of DC parent company Warner Bros. Discovery — tapped Jeremy Latcham to lead DC. He used to work at Marvel Studios, and coincidentally was a producer on Gunn's Guardians of the Galaxy.

item.title: How to get the Golden Scale in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how you obtain the Golden Scale in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, the item you need to dive deeper.
item.content:encoded: The Golden Scale is a unique item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake that allows Link to dive deeper. You can consider it an upgrade to the Silver Scale, an item that you obtain as young Link as you try to find Princess Ruto. However, unlike the Silver Scale, you can only get the Golden Scale after becoming adult Link.

item.title: What is the Business Scrub password in Zelda Ocarina of Time?
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Zelda Ocarina of Time's Business Scrub password is hard to find and tricky to use, but the reward is worth the effort
item.content:encoded: Getting the Business Scrub password in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is one of the trickier side quests you can tackle. It involves a bit of time travel, which means finding the password is something you can't do until roughly the middle of the game. However, it's worth the trouble, as the entrepreneurial little scrub has a very important item for you.

item.title: A Major 2027 Pokémon TCG Change Could Be Bad News For Everyone
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG retail/pricing story, not video game related.] Pokémon fans are already paying outrageous prices for new products, but regional changes alongside TPC's investments don't bode well
item.content:encoded: Being a Pokémon Trading Card Game fan is tough on wallets. Major retailers like Target and Walmart charge more than the manufacturer's retail price; stores like Best Buy, which stick to MSRP, are extremely competitive. Increased vendor prices and extraordinary resale price gouging are pushing more card shops to sell TCG products for or above market rates. And now, Pokémon fans are starting to fear that the hobby's pricing is about to get even worse across the board.

item.title: James Gunn's DCU Is Officially Dead, and That's Good News for Superman Fans
item.dc:creator: Jake Kleinman
item.description: [Filtered: DC Universe casting/production news without game adaptation relevance.] Did James Gunn ever really have a plan for his cinematic universe?
item.content:encoded: A popular online joke format in recent months goes something like this: If James Gunn had been in charge of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, what would his first three movies have been?

item.title: GTA 6 Jacket That Costs $3,000 Immediately Sells Out
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: [Filtered: Merchandise retail story, not substantive game news.] Despite costing over $3,000, the official Grand Theft Auto 6 jacket immediately sold out.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 will be the biggest game of 2026, and Rockstar Games certainly knows it.

item.title: All carpenter locations in Gerudo Fortress in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where you can find all the carpenters in Gerudo Fortress in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and the best route to reach each one.
item.content:encoded: The Gerudo guards captured four carpenters at Gerudo Fortress in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, and it's Link's job to rescue them. By heading west of Hyrule Field, you will enter Gerudo Valley. If you cross the broken bridge — which you can do by riding Epona — you can talk to the Master Craftsman, who will ask Link to help his apprentices by sneaking into the fortress and releasing them.

item.title: 7 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Elephants
item.dc:creator: Adam Barnhardt
item.description: [Filtered: Graphic novel excerpt/retrospective listicle, not substantive content.] A Far Side fan never forgets... about these elephant comic strips
item.content:encoded: For as long as humans have been telling jokes, elephants have made for unusually reliable punchlines. The metaphorical elephants in the room give comedians plenty to work with, but add in trunks, tusks, their reputation for never forgetting a moment, and the fact they look all around ridiculous trying to do anything remotely human, and there's practically an endless supply of material for elephant humor.

item.title: 6 Modern Fantasy Books That Rival The Lord of the Rings
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: [Filtered: Book promotion listicle outside gaming/horror focus.] From Brandon Sanderson's sprawling epics to ambitious new fantasy worlds, these six series give The Lord of the Rings a run for its money.
item.content:encoded: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings remains one of the most remarkable achievements in fantasy literature. Through the sprawling world of Middle-earth, ancient civilizations, intricate mythology, and its unforgettable journey of friendship and sacrifice, Tolkien created a fictional landscape that feels as tangible as New York City. More than seven decades after its publication, the story of Frodo Baggins and the Fellowship continues to set the standard for epic fantasy, inspiring generations of authors to dream bigger and build worlds of their own.

item.title: 19 Years Later, Avatar’s Most Terrifying Episode Changed the Franchise Forever
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective framing, not a new sequel/project announcement.] Avatar: The Last Airbender introduced bloodbending 19 years ago in “The Puppetmaster,” a terrifying episode whose legacy shaped The Legend of Korra.
item.content:encoded: For much of Avatar: The Last Airbender, waterbending seems like the most limited of the four elements for one practical reason: Its wielders need access to water. Firebenders generate their own flames. Earth is everywhere, and air is even more readily accessible. On her adventure with Aang, Katara is almost never separated from her water skin for this very reason. A waterbender in the desert is about as useful as a badgermole cub in a swimming pool.

item.title: 27 Years Later, Science-Fiction's Groundbreaking 4-Part Saga Is Free to Watch on Streaming
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait: free-to-watch movie availability.] Rediscover the groundbreaking sci-fi saga that changed action cinema forever, now streaming free on Pluto TV.
item.content:encoded: Some science fiction franchises are so ambitious they become their own cinematic languages. Star Wars built an entire galaxy with a mythology that’s still growing almost 50 years later, while Blade Runner helped define the vision of a far-future Los Angeles through rampant tech advancement and unchecked capitalism. They’re the kinds of franchises that can change the way we imagine the future, influencing everything from fashion and technology to the stories other filmmakers want to tell. Plenty of franchises have tried to capture that same vibe, but few have managed to pull it off quite like The Matrix.

item.title: Sega’s Most Influential Platformer Deserves Its Big Remake Moment Next
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old game from 25 years ago.] Not every remake has to be for a huge game. Some quicker plays from yesteryear could also benefit, like one all-time great from Sega.
item.content:encoded: With The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and even Star Fox recently proving there is still an appetite for remakes done right, other game publishers are likely looking at their backlogs for inspiration. Sega, no stranger to fantastic franchises, suddenly finds itself once more in an enviable position. It has a bunch of great old games ripe for revival, and several of them seem capable of making a mark again.

item.title: 25 Years Later, ‘Buffy the Vampire Slayer’s Best Quote Is Still the Most Inspiring Line in TV History
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old TV show, not new news.] Buffy’s sacrifice for Dawn in the season 5 finale gave us one of the show’s best quotes and an ending that could have closed the series for good.
item.content:encoded: Buffy’s story has always revolved around death. Throughout its seven-season run, Buffy Summers (Sarah Michelle Gellar) has wanted to escape from it or, boldly, return to it. Upon a rewatch, death is one of the clearest themes of the series — this wasn’t the case on my first time watching, when I reacted in disbelief every time the series brought up the possibility of Buffy dying. Surely, they wouldn’t go there. But they did.

item.title: All vault locations in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Vaults are full of valuable loot in Fortnite Chapter 7's mini season. Here's where to find them all and how to open them.
item.content:encoded: Vaults are locked locations around the map that contain rare chests and a sprite chest in FortniteChapter 7's mini season.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Opening Weekend Box Office Breaks A Foreign-Language Film Records
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: [Filtered: Box office reporting lacks substance; not prestige/highly anticipated.] Godzilla Minus Zero had a great first weekend in theaters
item.content:encoded: Godzilla Minus Zero had a strong opening weekend, grossing more at the domestic box office than any live action foreign-language film before it. On top of that, a higher percentage of people sought out premium screens, like IMAX, to watch it even more than they did for The Odyssey earlier this year.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Guaranteed a GOTY Nomination. It Will Never Win
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Speculative Game Awards prediction lacks substance or news value.] Nintendo's Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: OoT will do well at The Game Awards 2026, but it can't win
item.content:encoded: Here are the four remakes that were nominated: Resident Evil 2, Resident Evil 4, Final Fantasy 7 Remake, and Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth. Apart from the obvious, what these four games have in common is their bold retellings of the original stories in a completely modern gaming vernacular, sometimes with radical changes. The Final Fantasy 7 remake project turns one game into three that might as well be in a different genre.

item.title: 68 Years Later, Peanuts’ Most Mysterious Character Is Finally Making Her Official Debut — But There's a Catch
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.description: [Filtered: Peanuts comic strip retrospective; nostalgia piece unrelated to games/horror.] "Yeah, but Morag--" Hang on, we're covering that
item.content:encoded: There are some elements of Charles Schulz's Peanutscomic that have hardly aged at all, such as the characters' relationships or its focus on team sports. Most kids in America, before or since, have had the experience of being on a team where one kid is taking the game way too seriously while another seems barely aware of what's going on.

item.title: Anya Taylor-Joy's Billion-Dollar Sci-Fi Epic Officially Sets New Streaming Home on Netflix
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming availability clickbait about film adaptation; lacks substance.] Anya Taylor-Joy's epic space blockbuster arrives on Netflix in just a few weeks.
item.content:encoded: Anya Taylor-Joy captivated audiences as chess prodigy Beth Harmon in Netflix’s 2020 miniseries The Queen’s Gambit. Her performance balanced poise with emotional depth, creating a character whose story and presence have lingered with viewers long after the series ended. Even years later, the role remains especially memorable — more so than her appearances in action-packed franchises, including Fox’s Marvel superhero film The New Mutants.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney’s Extremely R-Rated 131-Minute Thriller Is Officially Streaming on HBO
item.dc:creator: Debopriyaa Dutta
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: streaming clickbait headline] Sydney Sweeney’s R-rated thriller The Housemaid is streaming on HBO, bringing 131 minutes of twisted secrets and suspense to your watchlist.
item.content:encoded: Despite its overwhelming commercial success, Freida McFadden’s psychological thriller, The Housemaid, is far from a perfect read. Trope-heavy and full of obvious contrivances, The Housemaid sets up a tense domestic thriller premise that is meant to be consumed as a fast-paced popcorn novel. This, however, sets the stage for a pulpy screen adaptation, one that mimics the conventions of a lurid thriller with some decent character writing to round things out.

item.title: Paramount’s 4-Part Action Fantasy Epic Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: [Filtered: Generic animated series retrospective/analysis, not prestige or anticipated.] In its third season, a beloved animated hero grows up the hard way, living with the fallout of her biggest choice and facing a chilling new villain.
item.content:encoded: Few things feel more grown-up than dealing with the consequences of your actions. Whether you stay up too late and still have to get up the next day or make a mistake at work and have to answer for it, adulthood means no one’s coming to fix things. For the most part, it’s all up to you.

item.title: How to Play Every GTA Game in 2026
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: [Filtered: Guide/walkthrough-style article about playing GTA games.] GTA might be the most popular video game franchise of all time, but a lot of it is hard to play. Here's a guide on how to play every GTA game.
item.content:encoded: Rockstar Games seems to have an ambivalent attitude towards GTA's past, particularly the early 2D games and some spinoff titles, and its record in making these games available is decidedly spotty. Below, we break down the current state of availability of every game in the series — where you can find it, and what the best way to play it is.

item.title: 4 Years Later, Captain Pike's Most Inspiring Star Trek Quote Is Still the Best Sci-Fi Line of the Decade
item.dc:creator: Terry Terrones
item.description: [Filtered: TV quote retrospective; not horror, prestige, or anticipated project.] Anson Mount's Captain Pike delivers a powerful Star Trek quote about hope, destiny, and why the future is still ours to shape.
item.content:encoded: For most of Star Trek's existence, Christopher Pike was little more than a footnote in franchise history. He was the captain of the Enterprise before James T. Kirk, a character whose greatest claim to fame was appearing in a rejected television pilot. Then Anson Mount came along and changed everything.

item.title: 5 Incredible Anime Arcs That Are 10/10, No Notes
item.dc:creator: Debopriyaa Dutta
item.description: [Filtered: Anime news falls outside video game focus; includes Naruto.] These anime storylines elevate these five series with thrilling character developments and satisfying resolutions.
item.content:encoded: Consider the Chimera Ant arc from Hunter x Hunter, which is nothing short of a rite of passage. It pushes the anime’s deconstruction of shonen conventions to its limits while sending Gon Freecss and Killua Zoldyck down starkly different paths. The Shibuya Incident arc from Jujutsu Kaisen is similarly transformative, shattering the established order of jujutsu society through its intersecting perspectives, major character deaths, and relentless succession of battles.

item.title: The No. 1 Horror Movie of 2026 Is Officially Leaving Peacock
item.dc:creator: Ashley Potter
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: streaming clickbait headline] Unless you have a One Wish Willow handy, you'll want to get in a final watch soon.
item.content:encoded: Not many directors can say their debut film was a blockbuster hit, let alone a cultural phenomenon. But newcomer Curry Barker, who wrote and directed Obsession, the No. 1 horror movie of 2026, can say he's accomplished both. The film takes a look at the dangers of getting exactly what you wish for when Bear (Michael Johnston) makes a wish that his friend Nikki Freeman (Inde Navarrette) would love him more than anyone else in the world. Despite being made on only a $750,000 budget, the film dominated the box office when it hit theaters, earning $17.2 million in its first week and a staggering $23.9 million in its second week.

item.title: Dropout’s Vic Michaelis Wants to Toss Their Star Wars Character Out a Window
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: [Filtered: Star Wars franchise churn; casting/set gossip interview.] Polygon spoke with Dropout's Vic Michaelis about their Star Wars Zero Company character Runa, one of the game's fan-favorite characters.
item.content:encoded: Dropout star Vic Michaelis used to fall asleep to Attack of the Clones. Not because they hated it, like so many Star Wars prequel detractors, but because it was their comfort watch. “I've seen the first 45 minutes of Episode II, I want to say, 300 times,” Michaelis told Polygon. “It's so comforting. The prequels hold a place in my heart where it is like nothing bad can happen when I'm watching them.”

item.title: GI Joe and Paranormal Activity Get New Official Release Dates from Paramount
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: GI Joe casting/news and streaming clickbait.] Paramount reveals the release date for Danny McBride's GI Joe reboot and delays the next installment in the Paranormal Activity series.
item.content:encoded: Paramount Pictures has announced that Danny McBride's G.I. Joe reboot is expected to premiere in movie theaters in late 2028. Unfortunately, not all news is good; Paramount has also pushed back the next installment in the Paranormal Activity horror series by six months.

item.title: One Of Hollywood's Biggest Stars Just Auditioned For James Bond
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: James Bond casting gossip without substance.] Robert Pattinson might be our next James Bond, according to new reports about the next James Bond film
item.content:encoded: As auditions for the next James Bond continue, new names are emerging and revealing which actors are up for the role. The latest on this from The Hollywood Reporter was particularly surprising, as it revealed some A-list Hollywood talent screen-tested for 007.

item.title: Ridley Scott’s R-Rated Sci-Fi Masterpiece is Officially Being Cut From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait: 'leaving Netflix' deadline list format.] Alien and Aliens are leaving Netflix on Dec. 1, giving subscribers limited time to stream Ridley Scott’s sci-fi classics.
item.content:encoded: Ridley Scott has directed some of the most iconic science fiction movies of all time, from Blade Runner to The Martian. However, few have had the same lasting impact as his 1979 sci-fi horror classic Alien. The film helped redefine the genre by combining the terror of a slasher movie with the vast, isolating setting of outer space, introducing audiences to one of cinema's most memorable monsters in the process.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Cows
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgic retrospective filler about decades-old comic strip.] Gary Larson's The Far Side often featured cows in funny situations. Here are the 10 funniest examples
item.content:encoded: From 1980 until 1995, cartoonist Gary Larson wrote and drew The Far Side. It was a single panel comic strip filled with non-sequitur, surreal jokes mostly aimed at adults instead of children, which was unusual for newspaper comics at the time. Also unusual was the fact that, unlike most daily comic strips, The Far Side had no recurring characters. Peanuts has its gang of kids and Garfield has its cast of humans and animals, but every panel of The Far Side introduces new characters and scenarios all aimed at delivering one single joke.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney's New Netflix Sci-Fi Epic Is Mandatory Viewing For Transformers Fans
item.dc:creator: Collier Jennings
item.description: [Filtered: Anime news (Gundam); Transformers is big-franchise churn.] Robots (not) in disguise.
item.content:encoded: Transformers is a franchise that has built-in appeal in more ways than one. Apart from the concept of giant robots transforming into vehicles, there's the fact that two factions of these robots have been engaged in a war that spans millenia. There have been highs (including the grossly underrated Transformers One) and lows (including most of Michael Bay's films), but it's more than likely that we'll be seeing Transformers stories until the heat death of the universe. Netflix is aiming to deliver its own take on another property that features giant robots, and it's tapped Sydney Sweeney to play a leading role in this potential franchise.

item.title: 5 Sci-Fi Series To Watch If You Love HBO's 'Lanterns'
item.dc:creator: Collier Jennings
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: DC/Green Lantern streaming recommendation list.] In brightest day, in blackest night, find your next binge watch tonight
item.content:encoded: HBO's Lanternsmore than delivered when it comes to being both a great comic book series and a great piece of television. Not only did the series thrive thanks to the dynamic between Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler) and John Stewart (Aaron Pierre), but it also managed to revitalize interest in the Green Lantern franchise following the less-than-stellar Green Lantern movie from 2011. That's a superhuman feat in and of itself, and Lanterns creators Damon Lindelof, Chris Mundy, and Tom King deserve credit for pulling that off.

item.title: 38 Years Later, Calvin and Hobbes' Lost Character Remains Bill Watterson's Biggest Failure
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old comic strip character from decades ago.] Uncle Max died on his way back to his home planet
item.content:encoded: The author Lois McMaster Bujold has said that “the writer should always reserve the right to come up with a better idea.” That's a useful guideline for any reader to keep in mind. As any long-form story evolves, it usually picks up a few dead plot branches or abandoned characters, because the author can exercise their option to drop what they're doing for any (or no) reason. Sometimes it's not a continuity error; it's a deliberate change in direction.

item.title: Ryan Gosling is Officially Reviving The Flintstones for New Project
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: Generic nostalgic reboot of old IP; not prestige or genuinely anticipated.] Ryan Gosling and Warner Bros are developing live-action Flintstones reboot about Bamm-Bamm
item.content:encoded: Ryan Gosling has been incredibly booked and busy of late. He starred in the lead role in the sci-fi smash hit Project Hail Mary earlier this year. In 2027, he'll travel to the galaxy far, far away in Star Wars: Starfighter. Then in 2028 he'll make his long-awaited MCU debut as Ghost Rider, re-teaming with Starfighter director Shawn Levy. If all that wasn't enough, Gosling has lined up one more unexpected project: The Flintstones.

That said, the series has had occasional growing pains over the years, even if true stinkers are a rarity among Rockstar Games’ back catalog. item.title: All Happy Mask Shop buyer locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] This guide walks you through each step of Ocarina of Time's Happy Mask Shop quest, including who gets the Spooky Mask, Skull Mask, and Bunny Hood
item.content:encoded: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake's Happy Mask Shop quest sends you around Hyrule peddling masks to specific customers. That sounds like a cushy gig, except you have very little guidance about who your customers are, and you occasionally even have to pay back the cost of the mask, too. However, if you want a big chunk of cash and a chance to see and hear everything in Ocarina of Time, it's worth the hassle.
